title: Greywater garden boundary card
summary: Sets safe boundaries for low-risk water reuse without contaminating food crops.
content: Greywater garden boundary card is a practical offline routine for water reuse safety. Separate greywater from toilet water, floodwater, chemical water, diaper water, and meat-cleanup water. Use only where local guidance and crop type make it appropriate; avoid contact with edible parts. Do not store greywater for long periods; use promptly or discard safely. Mark plants receiving greywater and monitor smell, pests, soil crusting, and plant damage. Keep greywater away from wells, springs, children play areas, and neighbors' property.
